title: The Terminal of Halcyon Drift
author: Elodie Whitlock
blurb: Xanthe Blackwood, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
